ideas.title: Following the Money in Daycare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail behind daycare fraud in Minnesota, including the sources of funding and the individuals involved.
questions: What are the sources of funding for daycare programs in Minnesota?
Who are the key individuals involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover a larger scheme involving multiple individuals and organizations. This could lead to a more comprehensive understanding of the issue and potential solutions.
